name: Will insulating my walls reduce outdoor noise levels inside my home?

mainEntity.name: Will insulating my walls reduce outdoor noise levels inside my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, insulating your walls can significantly help reduce outdoor noise levels inside your home. Insulation materials, particularly dense options like cellulose or spray foam, create a barrier that absorbs sound waves, preventing them from traveling as easily through your walls. While primary soundproofing often involves multiple strategies, improved wall insulation is a foundational step that contributes to a quieter and more peaceful indoor environment, especially in urban or high-traffic areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, wall insulation, especially dense types like cellulose or spray foam, can help reduce outdoor noise by absorbing sound waves.
